items.title: Porto Belo (SC) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 18 #PRI 153
items.en_title: Porto Belo (SC) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 18 #PRI 153
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Porto Belo (SC) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 118,396.80; proposals close Nov 18, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
